card.name: The 'aving' ending of lifesaving
card.fires_on: The ending piece of the word 'lifesaving' (after 'lifes'), mainly in warnings that a drug should be stopped unless it is lifesaving for the mother. It also fires faintly on the middle of 'caregiving'.

modes.label: Lifesaving in drug warnings
modes.description: The final piece of 'lifesaving' in sentences about stopping a drug when oligohydramnios is seen.
modes.example: If oligohydramnios is observed, discontinue captopril, unless it is considered lifes<<aving>> for the mother.

modes.label: Lifesaving with steroid therapy
modes.description: The same ending in text about chronic corticosteroid therapy being lifesaving.
modes.example: For medical conditions in which chronic corticosteroid therapy is lifes<<aving>> (e.g., immunosuppression
